Card Q&A.q: I digivolve a level 5 Digimon into this card. Can I place a red level 4 or lower Digimon card or level 7 Digimon card from my hand at the top of this card's digivolution cards?

Card Q&A.a: It becomes a level 3 Digimon. The digivolution cards placed below it remain, and their inherited effects can still be activated.
Card Q&A.q: I use this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect to place a level 3 Digimon card at the top of its digivolution cards. This Digimon is then targeted with a  effect, trashing this card. What happens to the Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: The  effect trashes this card, and the Digimon becomes a level 3 Digimon.  can't be used to trash any more cards once the Digimon it's targeting becomes level 3, and the effect ends. Any digivolution cards placed below it remain, and their inherited effects can still be activated.
Card Q&A.q: I use this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect to place a level 3 Digimon card at the top of its digivolution cards. This Digimon is then targeted with a  effect. What happens?

Card Q&A.a: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
Card Q&A.q: Multiple effects trigger when this card digivolves. In what order can they be activated?

Card Q&A.a:
No. If you activate  first, after activating any [When Attacking] or [When one of your Digimon attacks] effects, you activate the other [When Digivolving] effect before the counter timing occurs.
